name: sbox Dedicated Server - Native Linux Public Build
author: Dopamine-Sbox
description: Commit-pinned native Linux s&box dedicated server built from Facepunch/sbox-public. Installs the matching game artifacts into the server volume.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
commit="${SBOX_PUBLIC_COMMIT:-70647f994acb16cf780654dcfe3b5fee738a9f15}"
work=/mnt/server/.install-sbox-public
target=/mnt/server/serverfiles
apt-get update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates git
rm -rf "${work}"
git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/Facepunch/sbox-public.git "${work}"
git -C "${work}" checkout --detach "${commit}"
(cd "${work}" && dotnet run --project engine/Tools/SboxBuild/SboxBuild.csproj -- build --config Developer)
test -x "${work}/game/sbox-server"
if [ -d "${target}/config" ]; then mv "${target}/config" /mnt/server/.sbox-config-preserved; fi
rm -rf "${target}"
mv "${work}/game" "${target}"
if [ -d /mnt/server/.sbox-config-preserved ]; then rm -rf "${target}/config"; mv /mnt/server/.sbox-config-preserved "${target}/config"; fi
printf '%s\n' "${commit}" > "${target}/.sbox-public-commit"
rm -rf "${work}"
chmod +x "${target}/sbox-server"
echo "Installed sbox-public ${commit}"
